purpose: Evidence-bounded sourcing leads and blocked cross-division intake templates; not a final assortment or purchasing authorization.
evidenceCutoff: Repository evidence and explicit owner decisions only; no new web or supplier research.
authorityBoundary: Research may advance a lead toward sourcing but cannot establish a Blowin' Smoke SKU, supplier authorization, current formulation, price, inventory, proof, eligibility, compatibility, contents, media assignment, or image rights.

statusDefinitions.VERIFIED: Source or owner decision establishes the named scope.
statusDefinitions.PARTIAL: Relevant evidence/direction exists but production authority is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.BLOCKED: Requires an accountable owner or authoritative external source.
